question_text:
Aluminum alloy AA 6061-T6, steel AISI 4340 oil Q and tempered, and polyester $-30 \%$ glass fibers are being considered as a replacement for steel AISI 1025 normalized, in manufacturing a connecting rod to save weight. The connecting rod has a circular cross section and a length of 300 mm and is subjected to an alternating tensile load of 60 kN . Given the following information and assuming a derating factor of 0.4 on the fatigue strength for all alternatives, select the most suitable material:

AISI 1025: Tensile strength $=440 \mathrm{MPa}$, endurance ratio $=0.41$, specific gravity $=7.8$
AA 6061-T6: Tensile strength $=314 \mathrm{MPa}$, endurance ratio $=0.31$, specific gravity $=2.7$
AISI 4340: Tensile strength $=952 \mathrm{MPa}$, endurance ratio $=0.56$, specific gravity $=7.8$
Polyester $-30 \%$ glass: Tensile strength $=123 \mathrm{MPa}$, endurance ratio $=0.68$, specific gravity $=1.45$

Give your answer as a tuple: (AISI_1025_cross_section, AISI_1025_weight, AA_6061_T6_cross_section, AA_6061_T6_weight, AISI_4340_cross_section, AISI_4340_weight, polyester_30_glass_cross_section, polyester_30_glass_weight).The units of each required answer are (mm^2, kg, mm^2, kg, mm^2, kg, mm^2, kg), respectively.
response:
## Reasoning

**Step 1 — Derated fatigue strength for each material:**

The endurance limit (fatigue strength) is:
$$S_e = (\text{endurance ratio}) \times S_{ut}$$

With the derating factor of 0.4:
$$S_{e,\text{derated}} = 0.4 \times S_e$$

**Step 2 — Required cross-sectional area:**

The alternating load (60 kN) must not exceed the derated fatigue strength:
$$\sigma_a = \frac{F}{A} \leq S_{e,\text{derated}} \;\Rightarrow\; A = \frac{F}{S_{e,\text{derated}}}$$

**Step 3 — Weight:**
$$W = A \times L \times \rho, \quad \rho = \text{SG} \times 1000\;\text{kg/m}^3$$

| Material | $S_e$ (MPa) | $S_{e,\text{derated}}$ (MPa) | $A$ (mm²) | Weight (kg) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AISI 1025 | 180.40 | 72.16 | 831.49 | 1.9457 |
| AA 6061-T6 | 97.34 | 38.94 | 1540.99 | 1.2482 |
| AISI 4340 | 533.12 | 213.25 | 281.36 | 0.6584 |
| Polyester-30% glass | 83.64 | 33.46 | 1793.40 | 0.7801 |

**Step 4 — Selection:** AISI 4340 yields the lightest rod (0.6584 kg, ~66% savings over AISI 1025) thanks to its very high fatigue strength. AA 6061-T6 is the best *low-density* option (1.2482 kg, ~36% savings) and is the most suitable lightweight metallic alternative if corrosion/weight priority dominates; but purely on minimum weight, AISI 4340 wins.

$$\boxed{(831.49,\ 1.9457,\ 1540.99,\ 1.2482,\ 281.36,\ 0.6584,\ 1793.40,\ 0.7801)}$$
